title: modelXtChart equivalent to D_+(Xt) via the true chart presentation — v37-true-chart
description: v37-true-chart. modelXtChart is F2[a,b][X,Y,U,V] / (X·U, Y - X·V, Y^2 - X^3, U + X^2 + X·V^2). modelXtChart_equiv_DplusXt is chart_Dplus_Xt_true_presentation, a ring equivalence with D_+(Xt). The axiom report is propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The three-relation quotient without U + X^2 + X·V^2 remains modelRelationIdeal and is not the chart. chart_Dplus_Xt_presentation is the quotient D_+(Xt)/(a,b), not the full chart. lake build BealMathlibMissing and lake build BealEven exit 0. BealEven does not import Family.lean, ChartSurjection.lean, ChartTrueIdeal.lean, CentrePower.lean, or ChartInjective.lean. This is not a proof of the Beal conjecture. Code merge 84c03d5b.
